{"path":"/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/tasks/copper_melting_trial_3/in.melt","content":"# LAMMPS input script for melting copper
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/tasks/copper_melting_trial_3/copper_data.lmp

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Equilibration under NVT
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe etotal press vol
run 10000

# Relaxation under NPT
unfix 1
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000

# Heating under NPT
unfix 2
fix 3 all npt temp 300 2000 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 20000

# Output final density
variable mass equal mass(all)
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal v_mass/v_volume
print "Final density: ${density} g/cm^3""}
